projects.title: VeraMarket — Geolocated University Marketplace
projects.tagline: Campus marketplace with interactive mapping, direct student negotiation, and async backend
projects.summary_executive: Geolocated e-commerce platform built for the Universidad Autónoma de Occidente (UAO) community. Integrates real-time campus spatial navigation with Leaflet and OpenStreetMap, reactive state management in Next.js 14, and a high-performance RESTful API in FastAPI with PostgreSQL and PostGIS extensions.
projects.description: Modern monorepo architecture with clean separation of concerns. The presentation layer is built with Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Zustand for lightweight state management, supporting PWA features for instant mobile usage. The asynchronous backend, built in Python 3.11 with FastAPI and Pydantic v2, handles persistence via SQLAlchemy 2.0 async on PostgreSQL 15 with PostGIS for proximity queries, alongside JWT token authentication and bcrypt hashing.
highlights: Geospatial indexing with PostGIS for precise delivery and trading spots across campus grounds.
Decoupled monorepo architecture with strict OpenAPI contract validation and Alembic schema migrations.
Mobile-first PWA design with ultra-fast page load times and offline caching.
projects.architecture_details: Next.js 14 App Router with Zustand frontend; FastAPI with SQLAlchemy 2.0 Async, PostGIS, and Docker Compose backend.
projects.metrics: PostGIS Spatial Geolocation • Decoupled Monorepo • Mobile-First PWA • JWT/bcrypt Auth
projects.access_note: Private and confidential repository. Technical demonstration and source code available upon professional request.

projects.title: Nexo — Food Rescue & Redistribution Platform
projects.tagline: Serverless Progressive Web App for real-time connection between food donors and community kitchens
projects.summary_executive: High-impact civic technology designed to mitigate perishable food waste in Cali, Colombia. Connects food donors (restaurants, wholesale vendors) with community kitchens and recipient foundations in real time, enforcing strict cold chain compliance and route optimization for volunteers.
projects.description: Architected as a serverless Progressive Web App (PWA) optimized for low-to-mid-range mobile devices. Allows donors to publish food availability in under 60 seconds with automated refrigeration classification, ensuring perishable food is only routed to kitchens with verified cold-storage capabilities. Coordinates volunteer pickups without redundant dispatches and produces audit-ready impact metrics.
highlights: Automated cold chain verification and conditional assignment based on verified kitchen refrigeration.
Intelligent volunteer dispatch algorithm preventing duplicate logistics runs.
Instant generation of auditable social impact reports (kilograms rescued, beneficiaries served).
projects.architecture_details: Serverless PWA with TypeScript, decoupled modules, reactive synchronization, and low-bandwidth footprint.
projects.metrics: Low Operational Overhead • High Social Efficiency • Cold Chain Enforcement • Auditable Reports
projects.access_note: Institutional private repository (Nexo Cívico Studio). Source code and walkthrough available upon request.

projects.title: SERVICIUDAD Cali — Enterprise System with Canary Deployments
projects.tagline: Citizen services management system with Spring Boot 3, PostgreSQL, Docker, and NGINX canary proxy
projects.summary_executive: Corporate information system designed for municipal citizen services in Cali. Implements a layered Spring Boot 3 backend architecture with PostgreSQL, full Docker containerization, and a weighted Canary Deployment strategy via NGINX reverse proxy for zero-downtime releases.
projects.description: Three-tier enterprise architecture enforcing strict Controller-Service-Repository boundaries. Employs Spring Data JPA for ACID-compliant transactional persistence on PostgreSQL. Production traffic is split via NGINX weighted routing (90% stable production v1.0, 10% canary release v2.0), enabling live monitoring and telemetry before broad rollout without service interruption.
highlights: Weighted Canary Deployment with NGINX reverse proxy for seamless Zero-Downtime updates.
ACID-compliant transactional persistence and referential integrity via Spring Data JPA and PostgreSQL.
Container lifecycle orchestration for database, backend, and proxy services with Docker Compose.
projects.architecture_details: Spring Boot 3 on Java 17+, Docker Compose, NGINX Reverse Proxy with weighted canary routing, PostgreSQL database.
projects.metrics: Weighted Routing: 90/10 • Zero Downtime • ACID Transactional Core • Docker Orchestration

projects.title: Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & DevSecOps with OWASP ZAP

Microservices orchestration in Kubernetes with autoscaling policies and NGINX Ingress load balancing.
Real-time cluster observability via Prometheus + Grafana and automated DAST auditing with OWASP ZAP.

Strict separation of environment variables and deployment secrets using GitHub Secrets.

projects.title: Enterprise Network Topology & Routing Optimization with Graphs
projects.tagline: Telecommunications network modeling platform with shortest-path algorithms (Dijkstra / Prim)
projects.summary_executive: Interactive analytics platform for topological modeling and traffic flow optimization across corporate network backbones. Formally models point-to-point connections between branches and datacenters as weighted graphs G=(V,E), computing lowest-latency routes and minimum spanning trees.
projects.description: Developed with React 19 and Vite for instant rendering performance on dense graphs. Implements Dijkstra's algorithm to compute optimal point-to-point paths factoring in bandwidth and latency, alongside Prim's and Kruskal's algorithms to design minimum-cost trunk infrastructure. Features an intuitive visual canvas with dynamic telemetry indicators.
highlights: Efficient Dijkstra implementation using priority queues for optimal O(E log V) complexity.
Interactive Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) computation for infrastructure connectivity cost reduction.
Reactive rendering in React 19 with Tailwind CSS 4 and continuous integration pipeline via GitHub Actions.
projects.architecture_details: React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 frontend; pure decoupled graph algorithms implemented in optimized modern JavaScript.
projects.metrics: Route Computation O(E log V) • Dynamic Topology Visualization • React 19 • CI Passing

projects.title: Library Management on Linear Data Structures (LDS)
projects.tagline: Circulation simulation system modeled on Doubly Linked Lists, LIFO Stacks, and FIFO Queues
projects.summary_executive: Simulation platform for library loans, returns, and reservations founded on formal Linear Data Structures. Eliminates reliance on static arrays by utilizing doubly linked lists for bidirectional traversal, priority queues for waitlists, and transactional stacks with full Undo/Redo capability.
projects.description: Models document circulation lifecycle with strict attention to dynamic memory management and optimal algorithmic complexity. Catalog traversal utilizes Doubly Linked Lists enabling O(1) insertions and deletions when holding node references. High-demand reservations are queued via FIFO queues, while return operations are stacked in LIFO for reversible transactional history.
highlights: Linear data invariants formally maintained without buffer overflow or memory corruption risks.
Native Undo/Redo operation support via high-speed transactional LIFO stack.
Interactive UI developed in React 19 with Vite packaging.
projects.architecture_details: Dynamic linked nodes with prev/next pointers; independent FIFO queues and LIFO stacks with React 19 UI.
projects.metrics: O(1) Memory Invariants • Reversible History (Undo/Redo) • Zero Memory Leaks

projects.title: Linux Kernel Syscalls Research & Custom Kernel Compilation
projects.tagline: Custom system call implementation in C, sys_call_table dispatch customization, and kernel cross-compilation
projects.summary_executive: Operating systems research project exploring the internal architecture and context-switching mechanisms of the Linux Kernel. Implements new System Calls in C within Kernel Space (Ring 0), updates the sys_call_table dispatch map, and compiles a customized monolithic kernel.
projects.description: Experimental exploration of software interrupt dispatching (int 0x80 / syscall instruction) between User Space (Ring 3) and Kernel Space (Ring 0). Designed low-level C routines to capture process statistics, updated kernel headers and entry points, compiled the Linux kernel source with optimized module flags, and configured GRUB bootloader to boot the experimental kernel.
highlights: Registration and execution of custom system calls inside the Linux kernel core.
Deep understanding of User Mode to Kernel Mode context switches (Ring 3 to Ring 0).
Successful compilation and testing of custom Linux kernel with bootloader integration.
projects.architecture_details: Low-level C programming; modification of kernel sys_call_table; GRUB bootloader management.
projects.metrics: Kernel Space (Ring 0) • Kernel Compilation • Custom Syscalls • Context Switching

projects.title: Pentesting, Hardening & Secure Networks Lab with Vagrant
projects.tagline: Reproducible, isolated virtualized lab with Vagrant and VirtualBox for Linux security auditing and hardening
projects.summary_executive: Isolated, reproducible virtual laboratory built with declarative Vagrant specifications and Oracle VirtualBox. Designed for cybersecurity penetration testing, private network segmentation, and Linux server hardening using IPTables firewalls and Fail2ban brute-force protection.
projects.description: Client-server infrastructure defined in a parameterized Ruby `Vagrantfile`. Provisions two isolated VMs interconnected via Host-Only networking (`192.168.50.0/24`) with independent NAT gateways for outbound traffic. Applies rigorous defensive hardening policies on the target node: closing non-essential ports, packet filtering rules in IPTables, reactive alerting with Fail2ban, and packaging into portable Custom Boxes.
highlights: Declarative multi-machine provisioning with Vagrant and complete Host-Only network isolation.
Linux hardening policies: IPTables packet filtering, SSH defense, and Fail2ban monitoring.
Exporting hardened virtual machines as portable Custom Boxes for distributed lab environments.
projects.architecture_details: Ruby Vagrantfile; VirtualBox Hypervisor; Ubuntu 22.04 LTS; IPTables and Fail2ban for defensive security.
projects.metrics: 100% Isolated & Reproducible Lab • Linux Hardening • Private Network Segmentation

projects.title: Chronicles of Aethelgard: Concept Art & Worldbuilding
projects.tagline: Precision character design, fantastic architecture, and high-fidelity environmental aesthetics
projects.summary_executive: Series of conceptual illustrations merging the discipline of industrial precision drafting with digital concept art to establish an arcanotechnical civilization and its volumetric architecture.
projects.description: Comprehensive visual worldbuilding project. Employs descriptive geometry and three-point conical perspective honed over 7 years of industrial drafting education to construct intricate fortresses, complex machinery, and urban landscapes. Combines this spatial precision with digital painting techniques in Clip Studio Paint and Photoshop for character design, organic textiles, and volumetric atmosphere.
highlights: Development of character model sheets featuring front, side, and rear projections in exact proportion.
Construction of complex architectural backdrops with mathematically grounded geometric perspective.
Visual style guide and harmonious color palettes engineered for narrative continuity.
projects.architecture_details: Two-dimensional model sheets, 3-point conical perspective studies, and digital volumetric lighting.
projects.metrics: Collection of 18 High-Resolution Artworks • Institutional Recognition

projects.title: Cyber-Genesis: 3D Mech Animation Reel
projects.tagline: Precision 3D modeling, mechanical rigging, and cinematic keyframe animation in Blender
projects.summary_executive: Cinematic short film centered on the articulation and assembly of a biomechanical exoskeleton. Demonstrates realistic mechanical physics, procedural PBR shading, and dynamic sound design.
projects.description: Complete 3D audiovisual production developed in Blender. Features sub-d polygonal modeling of mechanical components with exact manufacturing clearances, procedural PBR materials with emission shaders, and inverse kinematics (IK) rigging with realistic rotational constraints. Keyframe animation timed according to the twelve classical animation principles, rendered in Cycles and composited in After Effects.
highlights: Rigging of over 40 interconnected rigid mechanical elements with collision-free rotational constraints.
Multi-pass Cycles rendering (Ambient Occlusion, Emission, Z-Depth) with professional color grading.
Sound design and foley synchronization delivered at 60 FPS in crisp 4K resolution.
projects.architecture_details: Sub-d modeling, inverse kinematics with mechanical constraints in Blender, and post-compositing in After Effects.
projects.metrics: 60 FPS Animation • >40 Moving Mechanical Components • 4K Rendered

projects.title: The Echo of Gears (Speculative Fiction Stories)
projects.tagline: Award-winning speculative fiction anthology and technical production screenplays
projects.summary_executive: Anthology of short speculative fiction stories and technical film screenplays exploring the intersection of human consciousness, mechanical automation, and social memory in retrofuturistic societies.
projects.description: Literary work and narrative compendium awarded in regional short fiction and essay contests. Employs classical three-act dramatic structure, deep psychological character motivation, and nuanced dialogue subtext. Includes the technical adaptation of two stories into production-ready film scripts with camera directions, lighting cues, and audiovisual pacing.
highlights: First prize winner in regional short fiction and speculative narrative competition.
Creation of cohesive fictional worlds with detailed societal and technological systems.
Structuring of bilingual production-ready screenplays (Spanish / English C1).
projects.architecture_details: Three-act narrative structure, character dossiers, and standard industry technical screenwriting format.
projects.metrics: Anthology of 5 Complete Stories • First Prize in Youth Short Fiction Contest
